limitations: The historical run-producing commit and branch were not recorded.
Historical NumPy, Torch, and Gymnasium versions were not recorded.
Historical initial weights, RNG states, replay, and environment state were not checkpointed.
Historical first-100 tracks are source-exact current-runtime reconstructions, not recovered historical bytes.
No new full training was authorized, so RNG and schedule effects were not causally isolated.

minimal_future_reproduction.proposal: After recovering or freezing exact dependency builds, run a seed-11 2x2 at 300k: historical/current reset stream crossed with historical/current collector-update schedule, with common recorded initial state and replay-sample fingerprints. Extend to all three seeds only if the seed-11 attribution is ambiguous.
